## What future work generates

- **Project State:** Every governed write produces an immutable successor Project State and appends its semantic and governance events; admitted state is never mutated in place.
- **Agent Context:** A future task creates a Context Request, immutable Context View, Agent Instance, and Agent Session. Session memory expires; durable continuity remains Project State.
- **Evidence:** Real work creates exact Sources and observations or measurements, then an Evidence Set whose members and lineage are digest-bound before Findings are asserted.
- **Ontology:** Semantic and governance event histories are replay sources. Ontology Nodes and Edges bind exact subjects and Typed Relations; Cuts and Views are derived and non-authoritative.

## Admission boundary

This candidate establishes only the durable operational roots and closed generation rules. Until Decision 0071 is applied, it has no authority effect.
